name: Riccardo Ali
description: Riccardo Ali's research, teaching, and talks on structure in machine learning.

profile.portraitAlt: Riccardo Ali smiling outdoors, wearing glasses and a blue shirt
biography: I study the geometric, algebraic, and information-theoretic structure of neural networks. I'm interested in how mathematical ideas can help us understand what models learn and how they make decisions.
My research spans symmetry and equivariance, representation learning, and interpretability in language models.

education.degree: BSc in Mathematics and Computer Science

researchIntro: My research explores how mathematical structure shapes what neural networks learn, from symmetry and geometry to information processing in language models.
